description: Scans text for prompt-injection patterns and returns a redacted copy plus findings. Pattern-based, not a guarantee — the result warrants review before being trusted. Free, anonymous, nothing stored; read-only with no side effects. Text is capped at 20000 chars; longer inputs are split into chunks, one call per chunk. Typical use is screening untrusted content (pasted text, web pages, tool output). Scope is text content; symptom-based agent health reads are outside this tool's scope. Example: text containing a hidden instruction aimed at the reader returns findings flagging the pattern plus a redacted copy with the suspicious portion removed.
name: qm_scrub
